title: The 2003 roadmap is titled a performance-based path to a two-state solution
summary: The 2003 roadmap's title is a performance-based path to a permanent two-state solution.
body: Avalon prints the 30 April 2003 document titled a performance-based roadmap to a permanent two-state solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The title states the goal. The card does not say the steps were carried out. The wording on the page includes: "of the Spokesman Washington, DC April 30, 2003 Performance-Based Roadmap to a Permanent Two-State Solution to the Israeli-Palestinian Conflict The following is a performance-based and goal-driven roadmap, with clear phases, timelines, target dates, and benchmarks aiming at progress through reciprocal steps by the two parties in the political, security, economic".

sources.title: A Performance-Based Roadmap to a Permanent Two-State Solution, 30 April 2003
sources.author: Avalon Project, Yale Law School
